editorial.description_en: The sky in the half hour after sunset, at its most saturated just before it gives up and goes black.
editorial.description_ja: 日が沈んだあとの空のような、あざやかな青。
editorial.contemporaryNote_en: The highest-chroma entry in this group. It is here to give the palette something to fail against — a blue this strong is where a camera estimate and a screen disagree most visibly.

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.470, C 0.118, h 262.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 宵 (yoi, early night) + 空 (sora, sky), rendaku to -zora. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Dusk Sky" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 宵空. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — yu-dachi at ΔE00 6.9, en-yo at ΔE00 8.2, fuka-mizu at ΔE00 8.5. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (82°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
